listing.name: Kula World — Kula World Rerolled (zap0xfce2)
listing.summary: Upstream reports reaching all ten worlds through Level Select and the ending movie. That does not establish a complete playthrough. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own PAL SCES01000 disc in BIN/CUE form.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the upstream release instructions or build from source. Keep your own disc available while playing.

warnings: Upstream reports reaching all ten worlds through Level Select and the ending movie. That does not establish a complete playthrough.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.

decisions.rationale: The immutable GitHub repository continued the same PAL SCES-01000 PSXRecomp implementation under the Kula World Rerolled name.

evidence.note: The recorded numeric ID resolves to the new repository name. The old GitHub URL currently resolves to the same ID.
The current README and the retained original README identify the same PAL SCES-01000 game, PSXRecomp implementation and BIN/CUE input.
The developer published an upstream release under the new name after the relocation.

decisions.reconsider_when: GitHub changes the repository identity, the stated game edition changes, or upstream reports a different continuing implementation.
